prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Next: View Controls", "Desktop Pet Controls & Shortcuts", "Learn how to move, hide, summon, and interact with your new companion on your screen.", "Right-click pet for menu. Double-click to talk. Click & drag to move."]
1: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion"]
2: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet Progress", "Create or sign in to your account first so your pet settings are preserved."]
3: ["Verify Desktop Display", "Desktop Display Health Check", "Testing pet overlay rendering on your main desktop monitor.", "Test Screen Overlay"]
4: ["Upload a clear, centered, well-lit photo of your pet's face for best 3D rendering result."]
5: ["Generating Your Pet's 3D Avatar", "Your pet is learning custom desktop animations and routines..."]
6: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Founder Edition Companion Unlocked"]
7: ["We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready to play!"]
8: ["Welcome Your Pet to the Desktop", "1. Drag pet to move. 2. Right-click for actions. 3. Double-click to talk."]
9: ["Sign In to Protect Your Progress", "Cloud Account Connected", "Your pet customization and progress will automatically back up to your account.", "Pet cloud backup active."]

verdicts.problem: Refers to a Founder Edition membership or special edition tier
